binding_gap: There is no formation hole — the squad fills its one legal shape exactly, with every place taken. Behind it, the real points gap is the third-attacker slot, where the incumbent is a rotation player with the weakest average in the squad — which is precisely what the live offer is aimed at.

Hold the offer, and be ready to sell Conte the moment it lands.
